# PR #4439: Patch: co-op match rebuilds and replay openings run through off_runtime

Closes #4430

## What changed and why

Co-op rebuilds and replay opens ran their whole-log folds on bare `tokio::task::spawn_blocking`, bypassing the `actor::engine::off_runtime` runner every other game mode uses. That skipped `app.engine_thread` setup (so test-kit card overrides never reached the worker thread) and, on the replay path, mapped engine panics to 422 `rules_changed` instead of a clean internal error.

- [registry.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4430/crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs): `DuosRegistry::rebuild` now folds via `actor_engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, …)`. Manual `catch_unwind`/`panic_text` and the two-stage error mapping collapsed to `.map_err(DuosAttachError::Internal)`. Checkpoint tail-fold logic untouched.
- [replay.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4430/crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs): `open` no longer catches panics (they propagate); `get_replay` runs `open` inside `off_runtime` within the permit closure, mapping a panic to `ApiError::internal` with the existing `duos.replay.panicked` log line. Non-panic refusals (unknown catalog, refused action, misrecorded result) still answer 422.
- Tests: two in [long_fold.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4430/crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs) (panicking rebuild → `Internal` + no actor + `/healthz` 200; test-card decks rebuild to the directly-folded hash with `next_seq() == 1`), one in [duos_rooms.rs](/home/agent-muse/actions-runner/_work/_temp/work/item-4430/crates/server/tests/api/duos_rooms.rs) (panicking setup → 500 `internal`, original match still 200).

## How it was tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::long_fold` — 4 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::duos_rooms::b41` — 11 passed.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server duos` — 140 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo fmt --check` clean; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
- Failing-first proof: ran the 3 new tests in an isolated worktree at the base commit with only the test files copied in. Observed: the test-card rebuild test and the b41 500 test failed there (replay answered 422 `rules_changed`), while the panic-→`Internal` test passed — exactly the behavior change. Worktree removed afterwards.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- Kept the `duos.replay.panicked` error log on the 500 path rather than dropping it: panics in production remain observable. Rejected silent conversion.
- New tests live in `long_fold.rs` / `duos_rooms.rs` rather than a new file, following the existing layout for #1035 and B41 coverage.
- No ruling note or spec edit: this is a pure refactor to the already-specified seams behavior (`crates/server/README.md`, #1035), so no `spec check` run was needed.

## For the reviewer

Look twice at the deliberate contract change: a replay whose setup/fold panics moves from 422 `rules_changed` to 500 `internal`, per the issue. The three existing 422 tests cover the non-panic refusal paths and stay green. Also note the `engine` name in both files is `duos::engine`, so the runner is called through the `actor_engine` alias — the fold calls themselves are byte-identical in behavior.

```text
# #4430: Patch: co-op match rebuilds and replay openings run through off_runtime
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

When players reconnect to an in-progress co-op match after a server restart, or open a finished co-op game replay to watch it, the server reconstructs the game board by replaying every card played so far. While 1v1 matches, daily games, and practice matches all route this heavy computation through a dedicated background thread manager that configures card rules and catches unexpected crashes cleanly, co-op games were running directly on generic worker threads without this setup.

This change routes co-op game reconstruction and replay opening through the standard background thread runner so that card rules, test overrides, and crash handling work identically across all game modes.

## Why

In `crates/server/README.md` ("The seams to the pure crates", lines 57–58), the server architecture explicitly specifies:
> "Every whole-log fold on an async path (a rebuild's three, a replay's opening, the reaper's, a finished match's one... and timing-backfill's) runs there too, one job per call, through `actor::engine::off_runtime`, its thread set up by `App::engine_thread` (#1035)."

While 1v1 rebuilds (`crates/server/src/actor/registry.rs:461`), 1v1 replays (`crates/server/src/api/replays.rs:419`), daily games (`crates/server/src/daily/games.rs:184`), and practice claims (`crates/server/src/api/practice.rs:201`) strictly obey this convention, co-op games were left out:
1. `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs:189` runs live co-op rebuild folds on bare `tokio::task::spawn_blocking`, manually duplicating `catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(...))` and `panic_text(payload)`.
2. `crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs:135` runs duos replay open folds on bare `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` without `catch_unwind`, risking crashing worker threads on unexpected engine panics instead of returning `ApiError::internal`.
3. In tests, `App::engine_thread` installs thread-local card catalog overrides (`test_engine_thread` in `crates/server/tests/support/test_app.rs:178`). Calling bare `spawn_blocking` bypasses `app.engine_thread()`, leaving blocking worker threads without the test harness's registered cards and overrides.

## Proposal

1. In `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`, update `DuosRegistry::attach` to execute the whole-log or checkpoint tail fold via `engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, move || ...)`. Map the error directly to `DuosAttachError::Internal`.
2. In `crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs`, update `open_duos_replay` to execute `open(&folding, actions)` inside `engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, move || ...)` within the permit closure, converting any fold panic cleanly into `ApiError::internal`.
3. Add a test in `crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs` (or `crates/server/tests/api/duos.rs`) asserting that an engine panic during co-op rebuild or replay opening returns an internal error cleanly without unhandled panics or leaving lingering actor registrations, matching 1v1 behavior.

## Where it lands

- Files:
  - `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`
  - `crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs`
  - `crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs`
  - `crates/server/tests/api/replays.rs`
- SPEC:
  - SPEC §9.3 ("The log is the source of truth")
  - SPEC §9.5 ("Matches")
  - SPEC §13.9 ("Co-op and 2v2 lifecycle")

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `DuosRegistry::attach` executes co-op log folding via `engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, ...)`.
- [ ] `POST /api/duos/replays/:matchId` executes replay log unfolding via `engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, ...)`.
- [ ] Panics during co-op rebuilds or replay opens are safely caught and surfaced as `DuosAttachError::Internal` or `ApiError::internal`.
- [ ] Thread setup from `app.engine_thread` runs on the worker thread before folding, ensuring test-kit catalog overrides apply.
- [ ] Existing duos tests (`cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server duos`) and long fold tests pass cleanly.

## Size and risks

- Size: Small (~35 lines changed in server sources, ~45 lines in tests).
- Risks: Very low. `engine::off_runtime` is the proven standard runner used by all 1v1, daily, and practice folds across the codebase.

## Goal

Route co-op game reconstruction and replay opening through the standard background-thread runner. `DuosRegistry` rebuilds fold via `actor::engine::off_runtime` with `app.engine_thread`, and `GET /api/duos/matches/:matchId/replay` opens via the same runner inside its permit closure. Engine panics on either path are caught and surfaced as `DuosAttachError::Internal` (rebuild) or `ApiError::internal` (replay open), and the worker thread runs `app.engine_thread` setup first so test-kit card overrides apply.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs` | change | `rebuild()`: fold via `actor_engine::off_runtime`; drop manual `catch_unwind`/`panic_text`; aliased import |
| `crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs` | change | `get_replay()`: open inside `off_runtime`; `open()`: drop inner `catch_unwind`, panics propagate to `ApiError::internal`; drop unused imports |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs` | change | 2 new tests: panicking rebuild → `Internal` + no actor; test-card rebuild proves thread setup |
| `crates/server/tests/api/duos_rooms.rs` | change | 1 new test in `b41_the_finished_replay`: panicking setup → 500 `internal` |

Must not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; no changes to `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, or `spec/`. This is a pure refactor so no ruling note and no spec edit; governing sections are SPEC §9.3 (log is source of truth), §9.5 (matches rebuild by folding), §13.9 (co-op lifecycle), plus the seams paragraph in `crates/server/README.md` and #1035.

## Steps

1. **`crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`, imports.** Delete `use std::panic::{AssertUnwindSafe, catch_unwind};` (line 15). Change `use crate::actor::registry::{AttachError, panic_text};` to `use crate::actor::registry::AttachError;`. Add `use crate::actor::engine as actor_engine;` (the name `engine` in this file is `crate::duos::engine`, so the runner needs the alias). Copy the pattern from `crates/server/src/actor/registry.rs:461`.
2. **`crates/server/src/duos/registry.rs`, `DuosRegistry::rebuild`.** Replace the `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` + `catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(...))` block (lines 189–209) with `actor_engine::off_runtime(app.engine_thread, move || { ... })`, keeping the closure body otherwise identical (checkpoint `verify`, tail-fold vs whole-log branch, `(folded, from)` return). Replace the two-stage `.map_err(...JoinError...)? .map_err(|payload| ...panic_text...)?` with a single `.await.map_err(DuosAttachError::Internal)?` (`off_runtime` already maps panics via `panic_text`). Everything after (`from` warning, `refused_at` handling, actor creation) stays byte-identical.
3. **`crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs`, imports.** Delete `use std::panic::{AssertUnwindSafe, catch_unwind};` (line 13) and `use crate::actor::registry::panic_text;` (line 23). Add `use crate::actor::engine as actor_engine;` (`engine` here is `crate::duos::engine`).
4. **`crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs`, `open`.** Remove the inner `catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| engine::steps_for(...)))`; call `let steps = match engine::steps_for(pinned, &options, &log, row.team_b()) { Ok(steps) => steps, Err(reason) => return DuosOpened::Refused(reason) };`. Keep the `Pinned::of` refusal and the `ended_as_recorded` check untouched. Update the doc comment: a refused setup/log is still `rules_changed` (as the 1v1 replay's), but a panicking setup/fold now propagates to the caller. The `duos.replay.panicked` log line moves to step 5.
5. **`crates/server/src/duos/replay.rs`, `get_replay`.** Before `replays.open`, add `let engine_thread = app.engine_thread;`. Replace the `tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || { let _permit = permit; open(&folding, actions) })` closure body (lines 135–140) with `actor_engine::off_runtime(engine_thread, move || { let _permit = permit; open(&folding, actions) }).await.map_err(\|message\| { tracing::error!(event = "duos.replay.panicked", matchId = %row.id, message = %message); ApiError::internal(message) })`. Keep `let _permit = permit;` inside the `off_runtime` closure (R3500000 permit accounting, exactly as 1v1 `open_uncached` in `crates/server/src/api/replays.rs:419` does).
6. **`crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs`, two tests.** Both build a `DuosMatch` like `crates/server/tests/actor/duos_checkpoints.rs:52-84` (`engine::match_options` with `Pinned::default()`, real catalog version, `Random` choices, `Difficulty::Easy`), write it with `tx.duos_matches_create` (no profiles needed; new `const DUOS_MATCH_ID: &str = "match-duos-long-fold";`), and call `jackioh_server::duos::registry::registry(&app).actor_for(&app, DUOS_MATCH_ID).await`. (a) `a_duos_rebuild_whose_fold_panics_is_an_internal_error_and_registers_no_actor`: set `row.options.decks.a1` and `.a2` to `vec!["not-a-card".to_string()]`, empty log; assert `Err(DuosAttachError::Internal(_))`, `registry(&app).live().is_empty()`, and `GET /healthz` is 200 (mirror the 1v1 test at line 148). (b) `a_duos_rebuild_installs_the_test_cards_before_folding`: call `install_test_cards()` before `empty_test_app()` (order as in the 1v1 gate test), set `a1`/`a2` decks to `fake_deck(&[])` (test-only filler cards), empty log; assert `Ok`, `actor.next_seq() == 1`, and `actor.hash()` equals `duos_engine::hash(&duos_engine::fold(Pinned::default(), &DuosReplayInput { options: duos_engine::create_options(&row), log: Vec::new() }).state)`. Test (b) fails pre-fix (pool thread without overrides panics on unknown test cards → `Internal`); both pass post-fix.
7. **`crates/server/tests/api/duos_rooms.rs`, `mod b41_the_finished_replay`, one test.** `b41_a_replay_whose_setup_panics_is_a_500_internal_error`: `let match_id = t.finished().await;`, then `let bad = copied(&t.app, &match_id, 904, \|row, _\| { row["options"]["decks"]["a1"] = json!(["not-a-card"]); }).await;`. Assert `replay(&t.app, &t.host, &bad).await` is status 500 with `code_is(&body, "internal")`, and the original `match_id` still replays 200 (nothing cached, no crashed worker). Pre-fix this returns 422 `rules_changed`; post-fix 500.
8. **Run:** `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::long_fold`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::duos_rooms::b41`, `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server duos`, then `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs`, `a_duos_rebuild_whose_fold_panics_is_an_internal_error_and_registers_no_actor`: bad-deck row rebuild → `DuosAttachError::Internal`, no registered actor, `/healthz` 200. Run with `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::long_fold`.
- `crates/server/tests/actor/long_fold.rs`, `a_duos_rebuild_installs_the_test_cards_before_folding`: test-card decks rebuild to the directly-folded hash with `next_seq() == 1`. Fails pre-fix, passes post-fix. Same command.
- `crates/server/tests/api/duos_rooms.rs`, `b41_a_replay_whose_setup_panics_is_a_500_internal_error`: copied finished match with `a1 = ["not-a-card"]` → 500 `internal`; original still 200. Run with `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::duos_rooms::b41`.
- Regression sweep: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server duos` (covers `actor::duos`, `actor::duos_checkpoints`, `api::duos_rooms`, `api::duos_again`).

## Done when

- [ ] Duos rebuild folds through `off_runtime(app.engine_thread, ...)`; no `spawn_blocking`/`catch_unwind` left in `duos/registry.rs`.
- [ ] Duos replay open folds through `off_runtime` inside the permit closure; no `spawn_blocking`/`catch_unwind` left in `duos/replay.rs`.
- [ ] Rebuild panic → `DuosAttachError::Internal`; replay-open panic → `ApiError::internal` (500), not 422.
- [ ] New tests fail pre-fix where specified and all pass post-fix; `duos` and `long_fold` suites green.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. (No `spec check` needed: no ruling added or cited.)

## Risks

- Deliberate contract change: a replay whose setup/fold panics (e.g. a deck the catalog now refuses) moves from 422 `rules_changed` to 500 `internal`, per the issue's acceptance criteria. The alternative (keep the inner catch mapping panics to `rules_changed`, 1v1-style) was rejected because the task explicitly requires `ApiError::internal`. The three existing 422 tests stay green: unknown catalog version, refused log action, and misrecorded result are all non-panic `Refused` paths.
- `engine` already names `duos::engine` in both files: the builder must use the `actor_engine` alias, never rebind `engine`, or the fold calls change meaning.
- The `off_runtime` closure must stay `FnOnce() -> T + Send + 'static`: move `saved`, `checked_row`, `checked_log`, `input`, `pinned` in (rebuild) and `folding`, `actions`, `permit` in (replay); keep `let _permit = permit;` inside the closure so R3500000 accounting is unchanged.

## Open questions

None.
